name: unipass
description: UniPass – Smart Event Booking & Secure Entry Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently --prefix-colors "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold" --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
